$comment: Single source of truth for the playground: every app listed here exists in apps/<id>/ and is built and shown in the gallery.
`id` is immutable: it is the folder name under apps/, the URL segment, and the key used to derive the GitHub and CLI links.
Build output is assumed to be 'dist'; add "outDir" only when the toolchain differs (e.g. Next.js static export writes to 'out').

apps.name: Starter
apps.description: The smallest setup that still shows what Morphic Blocks is made of: elements, modes and views, with one mount call and five short behaviors.
apps.details:
Each of the five blocks (print, text, number, math and repeat) has five elements: a title, an icon, a one sentence hint, pseudocode and JavaScript. Three modes pick from these elements, one per view: toolbox tiles show title, icon, block and hint; the workspace shows plain word pseudocode; the code view shows JavaScript and is editable by structure.

A small ⓘ button next to each pane names the mode it shows. Run executes the program and shows what it printed. Copy this app to start your own project.
